# Wasmtime dependency

The C# runtime references the `Wasmtime` NuGet package, version **48.0.2**.
NuGet metadata identifies source commit
`d9db6b0005b93ba09a6ada8ddce2d5a3846511eb` in
[bytecodealliance/wasmtime-dotnet](https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime-dotnet).

[LICENSE](LICENSE) is the unmodified Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception license
from that commit. The .NET tool package includes this notice alongside the
redistributed .NET binding and native runtime libraries. NuGet lock files pin
the package content hash. No Wasmtime source is copied or modified here.
